verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page claims "one-click reporting on your team's performance with a flexible data export," which points to some team or incident performance reporting. Nothing in the pack names MTTA/MTTR, trend views, incident-load breakdowns or on-call health metrics. missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR metrics and trend charts, incident load analytics, on-call health/burden reporting, in-depth docs on the reporting feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
